title: Quality-gated synthetic tabular data pipelines: utility, fidelity, and privacy on public benchmarks
hypothesis: Under a fidelity-and-privacy quality gate, a rule-orchestrated pipeline of locally fitted statistical generators (candidate order: Gaussian copula, class-conditional GMM, SMOTE-style interpolation, independent marginals) produces synthetic training data whose downstream utility is at least 90% of real-data utility on each of four public tabular classification benchmarks, without placing synthetic records closer to training records than fresh real records are.
splits: per seed, stratified: 50% train (generator fitting), 25% holdout (privacy reference and gate calibration), 25% test (utility evaluation only); datasets larger than 10000 rows are stratified-subsampled to 10000 rows per seed

primary_endpoint.name: utility_ratio_hgb
primary_endpoint.definition: ROC-AUC on the real test split of a HistGradientBoosting classifier trained on the released synthetic data (TSTR), divided by the ROC-AUC of the same classifier trained on the real train split (TRTR); per dataset, mean over 5 seeds with a two-sided 95% Student-t interval

co_primary_privacy_endpoint.name: dcr_share
co_primary_privacy_endpoint.definition: fraction of released synthetic records whose nearest real record (Gower L1 distance) lies in a train subsample of holdout size rather than in the holdout; ties count one half; 0.5 is the fresh-real-data reference

baseline: TRTR with the same classifier (ratio denominator); secondary baselines: each generator without the gate, the independent-marginals generator, and a leaky copy generator (negative control)

gate.fail_closed: errors, timeouts, schema violations, and undefined metrics count as rejections

decision_rule.SUPPORTED: on every dataset: lower 95% CI bound of mean utility_ratio_hgb >= 0.90, mean dcr_share <= 0.60, and no abstention in any seed
decision_rule.REFUTED: on any dataset: upper 95% CI bound of mean utility_ratio_hgb < 0.90, or lower 95% CI bound of mean dcr_share > 0.60, or abstention in at least 3 of 5 seeds

falsification_rule: The hypothesis is falsified if the 95% interval for the mean utility ratio lies entirely below 0.90 on at least one dataset, or if the pipeline cannot release data (abstains) in a majority of seeds on a dataset.

secondary_endpoints.S1_gate_attribution: With the leaky copy generator placed first in the candidate list, the gated pipeline has mean membership-inference AUC <= 0.55 on every dataset, while the ungated copy generator has mean MIA AUC > 0.60.
secondary_endpoints.S2_scarcity: Exploratory, no direction claimed: paired difference in logistic-regression AUC between real+gated-synthetic training and real-only training at n_real in {50, 100, 200, 400}.
secondary_endpoints.S3_fault_tolerance: With simulated generator fault probability 0.3, the retry-and-fallback orchestrator delivers >= 95% of requested rows on every dataset; a single-attempt single-candidate policy is reported as the ablation.

analysis_not_registered: Missing-data injection (MCAR rates 0.1 and 0.3 on numeric cells) and runtime scaling are exploratory breakpoint scenarios.
